chapters: Ask for a new editor tool
newSections: Self-healing and editor extension remain inside the app. All added editorial slides removed; narration carries the transitions.

sceneNarration.line: Your editor can evolve, too. Ask your coding agent to add a missing editor tool.
It updates the editor, checks the change, and reloads the plugin in place.
The export tool appears in the toolbar. No reinstall.
Click it to export this agent's diagnostics, including its test results.
Keep working in the same editor, with the new tool ready to use.

provenance: Requested scripted scene: real app and Monaco; injected demo assistant, toolbar button, export dialog and downloadable sample JSON in an isolated profile. No installed product changes.
